invariants_checked: Authoritative API-key scope gating in CanViewIntegrationSecrets and CanViewTenantAPIKey: when TenantAPIKeyScope is present on context, narrowed scopes and platform scopes never inherit Admin/Owner secret access from RoleFromContext.

Consistent tenant response redaction in NewTenantResponse, NewTenantResponseWithRole, and NewTenantResponsesCrossTenant: integration config blocks are redacted with RedactedSecretPlaceholder and exposed only to Admin+ members, full-access tenant API keys, or manage_tenant_settings API keys; cross-tenant listings force Viewer redaction.

Secret-by-construction omission in ModelResponse, MCPServiceResponse, WebSearchProviderResponse, and DataSourceResponse: API keys, OAuth tokens, and auth headers are excluded from response structs (exposing boolean CredentialFieldMetadata only), while internal BaseURL/URL/ProxyURL/Env/ExtraConfig details are stripped for non-admin Viewers and chat-only API keys.

AuthLoginResponse and AuthOIDCCallbackResponse sanitize embedded User.Tenant associations before JSON serialization so unredacted GORM Tenant fields never leak alongside redacted ActiveTenant/Tenant DTOs.
GENYEE JSON field contract consistency and zero weknora/knora/wk_ residues verified across all 15 files.

findings.summary: CanViewIntegrationSecrets checked RoleFromContext before TenantAPIKeyScopeFromContext, CanViewTenantAPIKey ignored TenantAPIKeyScopeFromContext, apiKeyCanManageIntegrationSecrets did not exclude platform scopes on FullAccess, and NewTenantResponse checked RoleFromContext instead of CanViewIntegrationSecrets (allowing narrowed scopes layered on Admin/Owner contexts to bypass scope restrictions while stripping redacted config blocks from manage_tenant_settings API keys).

NewWebSearchProviderResponse stripped ProxyURL and ExtraConfig for non-admin Viewers and chat-only API keys, but left Parameters.BaseURL exposed in plaintext, leaking private self-hosted search gateway endpoints (unlike ModelResponse and MCPServiceResponse).

NewAuthLoginResponse and NewAuthOIDCCallbackResponse serialized resp.User directly without clearing an eager-loaded User.Tenant pointer, which would serialize unredacted Tenant integration secrets in plaintext alongside the redacted ActiveTenant/Tenant DTO.

invariants_checked: Strict session ownership and workspace isolation (GetOwnedSession vs read-scoped GetSession) enforced across KnowledgeQA, AgentQA, ContinueStream, StopSession, SteerMessage, PromoteSteerMessage, DeleteSteerMessage, ForkSession, RewindSession, GenerateTitle, Pin/Unpin, Update/Delete/BatchDelete/ClearSessionMessages, temporary document CRUD, artifact download/library/delete, background work list/get/cancel, sandbox terminal/desktop ticket & WS bridges, local browser skill controls, and HITL ResumeSuspendedRun.

Machine API-key boundaries enforced: API keys run in unattended non-suspendable mode, cannot bind host workspace directories (project_dir) or switch host-approval-mode to auto, cannot access personal local-browser extension controls via synthetic owner UserIDs, cannot mint interactive terminal/desktop WS tickets, cannot resume suspended interactive HITL runs, and must pass AuthorizeTenantAPIKeyKnowledgeTargets on both QA and mid-run SteerMessage @mentions.

Public embed and share link isolation verified: signed X-Embed-Session handles bind session + channel + tenant, public resource URL rewriters mint short-lived scoped tokens without exposing raw storage credentials, and shared-agent runs pin execution tenant without leaking lending-workspace model overrides, parser overrides, or upstream ASR endpoint details.

Bounded request bodies and pre-decode base64 checks enforced via http.MaxBytesReader across chat QA, SearchKnowledge, public embed / authenticated StopSession, SteerMessage, GenerateTitle, CreateSession, UpdateSession, BatchDeleteSessions, ForkSession, RewindSession, SetHostApprovalMode, BrowserSkillConnection/Account, UploadTemporaryDocument, and TranscribeVoiceInput.

SSE, WebSocket (terminal PTY and desktop RFB), and background/HITL lifecycles verified race-free under -race: bounded WS frame sizes (ReadLimit), periodic 60s live token/membership/ownership revalidation with immediate teardown on revocation, Redis/in-process desktop slot takeover & lease renewal without goroutine/timer leaks, and clean turn-lease/disconnect cancellation.
GENYEE contract consistency, preserved BrowserSkill reserved identifiers per REBRAND_RESERVED.md, and zero weknora/knora/wk_ residues verified across all 95 files.

findings.summary: Routes under /sessions accept chat-capable API keys (which middleware binds to the workspace owner's synthetic UserID), yet SetHostApprovalMode allowed API keys to switch host-approval-mode to 'auto', CreateSession allowed API keys to bind approved host project_dir paths, and BrowserSkillConnection allowed API keys (and userless contexts) to inspect/control the human owner's personal Chrome extension.

StopSession (reachable anonymously via public /embed/:channel_id/sessions/:session_id/stop), SearchKnowledge, SteerMessage, GenerateTitle, CreateSession, UpdateSession, BatchDeleteSessions, ForkSession, and RewindSession called ShouldBindJSON without http.MaxBytesReader (and decodeQueryImage decoded arbitrary-size base64 before checking maxQueryImageBytes); StopSession also called read-scoped GetMessage before GetOwnedSession, used an unchecked tenantID.(uint64) assertion, and lacked a nil-message guard.

ResumeSuspendedRun lacked a nil-prompt guard, and buildResumeRequest loaded the target session via read-scoped GetSession instead of strict GetOwnedSession without rejecting API-key callers or verifying prompt/caller tenant binding, allowing read-only admin visibility on non-owned sessions to satisfy session lookup during HITL resume.

GetSessionsByTenant wrapped all ListSessions errors in 500 Internal Server Error, masking typed 403 Forbidden (non-admin source filter) and 400 Bad Request AppErrors returned by sessionService.ListSessions.

SteerMessage neither rejected SessionKindAgentDelegated nor enforced AuthorizeTenantAPIKeyKnowledgeTargets on @mentioned KB/knowledge items; TranscribeVoiceInput attached raw upstream ASR err.Error() via WithDetails (exposing internal/shared-workspace ASR endpoints in HTTP error responses); temporary_document handlers read c.GetUint64('tenant_id') instead of session.TenantID without nil-service guards; and deleteArtifact called MustTenantIDFromContext (panicking if tenant context key was absent).
